collection.description: The sea is blue, but water scooped up in the hands is perfectly clear. A villager wants to know why.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The sea is blue. Everyone knows that. But when (subject) scoops it up in (subject.his/her) hands, the water is perfectly clear. (subject.He/She) tries again. Clear. (subject.He/She) carries a full bowl up the beach and looks at it. Clear. The sea, just behind (subject.him/her), is as blue as ever.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "Maybe it's the sky," says (friend). "Maybe the sea is just reflecting it." "But on cloudy days it's still sort of blue-grey." "Maybe it remembers being blue." They look at the bowl of water. It doesn't seem to remember anything. They pour it back, to be on the safe side.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) decides the problem is the size of the bowl. A big enough bowl must turn blue. (subject.He/She) fills the biggest pot in the village. It is, very faintly, a tiny bit blue. Maybe. If you squint. (subject) counts this as proof of something, (subject.he/she) just isn't sure what.
